record_scope_reconstruction: Zambian Kazungula checkpoint controlling livestock/meat imports from Botswana in 2019. The applicable route was the ferry-era Botswana–Zambia crossing, distinct from Zimbabwe’s road post and the later bridge.

source_checks.finding: Veterinary official says checkpoints were mounted at Kazungula–Botswana, Livingstone–Zimbabwe and Chirundu; the retained phase selects Kazungula only.

Original report describes the pre-bridge Kazungula ferry and states the new OSBP/bridge infrastructure was completed in 2021; therefore its current illustrative bridge marker cannot locate the 2019 restriction.
